Name: Silly Farm
Author: leafiot
Description:
A Silly Farm for farmers who likes a bit more space in the original and tastefully hidden ponds(I don't know how to code watering pans lol). Also added a section below for people who love trellis and beanstalks, silos and decor! Tillable Grass for all ofc.

Note: Only replaces Meadowlands Farm. Does not replace any other(Unless you edit the config.json yourself, change Farm_Ranching to other if you wish, just can't promise the mod would work as intended. To my knowledge, Beach farm seems to have a completely different layering scheme???????).

Additional: Zoom level doesn't fit the size of the map(im using a mod for this, yes im very silly). Media IS cropped.
Additional additional: Last two images are MY current progress while using this mod(on Year 3, and yes, its still a very rough wip. This was a previous iteration, might show bushes being in the wrong place www) Hopefully this offers some inspo for your own farm? gl yall!
